Sobre a vaga

Fast Dolphin is an international staffing company with over two decades of experience specializing in recruiting bilingual and multilingual IT and Engineering experts across the Americas and providing payroll and customized staffing solutions. Moreover, we take pride in boosting the careers and dreams of our professionals.

We are seeking an Oracle EBS Master Data Engineer to work remotely in Latin America.

Job title: Oracle EBS Master Data Engineer

Duration: 12 months plus extensions

Start date: as soon as possible

Location: remote

Key Required Skills:

- Advanced English level.

- Strong experience in Master Data Management within enterprise IT environments.

- Experience working with Oracle EBS.

- Hands-on experience with Item Master Data.

- Solid understanding of data quality dimensions Accuracy, Completeness, Consistency, Validity.

- Experience working with data quality, profiling, and remediation tools.

- Strong SQL and/or data manipulation skills.

- Ability to operate independently and accelerate delivery.

- Experience working as part of a nearshore delivery model.

If you fulfill these requirements and are interested, please send your resume along with your desired rate and availability to the following e-mail address: ricardo.padilla@fastdolphin.com

Ricardo Padilla

Talent Acquisition Lead

Fast Dolphin, Inc.

www.fastdolphin.com
